landing.metaTitle: OneFrame · AI Anime Drama Studio — one episode in 30 minutes
landing.heroTitle: Your own AI anime drama studio
landing.heroLead1: Paste a novel or type one sentence — AI writes the episode outline, character designs, storyboards and video.
landing.heroLead2: Characters stay consistent; pricing stays transparent.
landing.heroHint: Alpha is invite-only · 80 credits on sign-up · No payment method required
landing.flowStudioDesc: From script to finished cut — one place for hit short dramas

landing.capScriptDesc: Novel or one sentence → episode outline → character designs → shot list → batch generation. Every step is editable and can be re-run.
landing.capCharacterDesc: Once a reference design is bound, it is injected into every shot, so faces stay the same across shots and episodes.
landing.capPriceDesc: Model costs and credit conversion are published, quotes are live before generation, and failed or cancelled jobs cost nothing.
landing.capBatchDesc: Queue whole episodes or selected shots and cap the budget in one click; shots that hit the cap keep partial results and can be re-queued.
landing.capAssetsDesc: Results are saved to the asset library, character designs are tagged for cross-project reuse, and works can continue into the next episode.
landing.capAiDesc: A watermark on rendered frames plus file metadata — meeting generated-content labelling requirements.
landing.pipeSectionTitle: Six steps from idea to finished cut
landing.pipeSectionDesc: About 30 minutes of hands-on work; 2 hours or less end to end including queueing.
landing.pipe1Desc: Paste a novel or a one-line idea, then pick the aspect ratio
landing.pipe2Desc: AI splits it into 3–6 episodes you can edit line by line; auto-saved
landing.pipe3Desc: Extract character cards, generate reference designs and lock them in
landing.pipe4Desc: 4–30 shots per episode with numbers, visuals and prompts
landing.pipe5Desc: Pick models and budget, then queue every shot at once
landing.pipe6Desc: Download shot by shot or the whole episode as a zip with a manifest
landing.finalDesc: Alpha is invite-only. Sign-up comes with 80 credits — enough for a full episode.
landing.footerNote: Content is AI-generated — please review carefully · ICP filing 00000000 (placeholder before launch)
landing.metaDescription: Paste a novel and get storyboards and video in one pass: script pipeline, character consistency, transparent pricing. An AI anime and short-drama production studio.

teamPage.title: Team management
teamPage.memberOnlyHint: You are a team member ({role}) and can only view; editing requires an admin/producer role.
teamPage.noMembers: No members yet. Team members collaborate on production and share credits — click “Invite members” at the top right.
teamPage.poolLine: The team credit pool currently holds {total} credits{frozen}.
teamPage.poolHint: Topping up places an order for the team space; once credited you can allocate it to members with the forms below.
teamPage.allocateRulesText: Allocate = team pool → member balance; recover = the reverse. Every allocation/recovery writes two ledger entries (one out, one in), so “team pool + all member balances” is conserved and auditable. A member's “current credits” is the allocated quota, not a balance.
teamPage.allocateHint: Transfer from the team pool to a member's personal space (paired entries: pool decreases, member balance increases).
teamPage.recoverHint: Take credits back from a member's personal space (member balance decreases, team pool increases; the allocated quota drops).
teamPage.noFlows: No team credit ledger entries yet
teamPage.groupStatsHint: Member count / tasks of this group in this team space / consumed credits / allocated credits (from the ledger).
teamPage.switchNote: Switches derive from {from}; “not evidenced” means the server has no basis to decide — we do not fake a false “not supported”.

rules.pool: The team credit pool is the team space's available balance, not a separate ledger; allocation/recovery are transfers between spaces.
rules.quota: A member's “current credits” is the allocated quota (the un-recovered cap), not a balance — it drops after a recovery.
rules.pair: Each allocation writes two ledger entries (team out + member in), so total credits are conserved system-wide and auditable.
rules.consume: Inside the team space members spend the team pool; in their own personal space they spend their personal balance.
rules.role: Roles decide what you can do: admin/producer/production roles manage members and credits; creative roles such as director/writer only take part in production.
rules.seats: Seats come with the subscription tier; adding members when full shows “seats are full”.

teamPage.inviteHint: Enter phone numbers separated by spaces or commas (up to 50 per request). Only registered accounts are supported — accounts are never created on the fly, and unregistered numbers are reported one by one.
teamPage.seatsHint: Seats cannot be lower than the current member count ({count}); lowering it will be rejected.
teamPage.batchHint: Allocate the same amount to each of the {count} selected members; each runs independently and members short of credits fail individually (without affecting others).
teamPage.createTeamHint: Teams are for multi-person production and credit allocation. After creating one you become the team master and can invite members, create groups and allocate team credits.
teamPage.inputPhones: Please enter at least one phone number
teamPage.positiveCredits: Please enter a positive whole number of credits
teamPage.noFlowsToExport: No team ledger entries to export
